# Status-coverage fixtures (EVAL.md §Datasets and fixtures — status coverage; ADR-0011).
# Pipe-delimited:  category | expected_status | puzzle(81) | note
#
# Categories that produce a solver STATUS from a PARSEABLE grid live here. The fourth AC-5
# category, invalid_input, is exercised inline in status_coverage_test.go (those grids do NOT
# parse, so they never reach the solver — invalid_input is decided at sudoku.Parse, ADR-0011).
#
#   above_tier_stalled  -> stalled     : valid, UNIQUE, but its hardest required technique is a
#                                        forcing chain / ALS above the ADR-0002 tier, so the
#                                        constructive solver honestly stalls (ADR-0001/0002).
#                                        PROVISIONAL: the label rests on published provenance;
#                                        build-time confirms these stall against the full tier.
#   non_unique          -> stalled     : >=2 solutions (brute-force verified). ADR-0011: the
#                                        solver returns STALLED (never unsolvable) for non-unique.
#   in_tier_unsolvable  -> unsolvable  : a cell is driven to ZERO candidates by the givens — an
#                                        in-tier constructive contradiction the solver reaches.
